name: writing-agents-md
description: Writes (generates or updates) AGENTS.md — a token-efficient context file for AI coding agents. Analyzes project stack, constraints, and commands. Produces AGENTS.md and agent-specific imports (CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, GEMINI.md, etc.). Preserves curated sections on update. Also reviews an existing AGENTS.md read-only (runs the bundled critic; writes nothing). Use when: the user asks to create, update, or review AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or agent context files; or to onboard an AI agent to a project.
